title: [Master] [Repair Item] Team Member unable to copy sales quotation when lines are associated to assembly
summary: Fixed an issue where copying sales quotations failed when document lines were associated with assembly items. The fix adjusts handling in the Copy Document Management codeunit to properly process assembly-linked lines.
key_points: Resolves copying failure for sales quotations with assembly-associated lines
Updates Copy Document Management logic across multiple localization layers
Includes test coverage for the assembly line copy scenario
Affects team member workflow in repair item processes
